subject.title: Feature Request: Per-agent context/workspace on model fallback

question: Should OpenClaw model fallback switch to another agent/workspace, apply a model-specific context profile, or stay model-only with narrower fallback notification/re-injection behavior?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the permanent public API affects config schema, session identity, agentDir/workspace ownership, auth routing, skills snapshots, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the product shape.

options.title: Choose a fallback context profile contract
options.body: Define a first-class model or fallback context profile that controls bootstrap budget/files, skills visibility, and session-safe context without changing agent identity by default.

options.title: Add fallback agent or workspace switching
options.body: Allow a fallback attempt to select another configured agent or workspace, but require explicit session/auth/state semantics and migration proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer to narrower fallback issues
options.body: Keep fallback model selection unchanged for now and solve only notification, re-injection, or model-key subproblems in their own threads.

recommendation.title: Choose a fallback context profile contract
recommendation.body: Define a first-class model or fallback context profile that controls bootstrap budget/files, skills visibility, and session-safe context without changing agent identity by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the design-oriented keep-open review and has recent shared agent model schema/config history.
